newsitem.title: USA: Continental jet suffers pressure problem.
newsitem.headline: Continental jet suffers pressure problem.

text.p: A Continental Airlines jet bound for Orlando, Florida, was forced to return to Houston Tuesday after the Boeing 727 suffered a cabin pressure problem, an airline spokeswoman said.
None of the 149 passengers on board flight 1512 were injured, although a few complained that they had earaches, said Saray Anthony, a spokeswoman for Continental Airlines Inc..
"The flight was about 15 minutes (out of Houston) when there was a problem with pressurization ... the pilot declared an emergency as a standard precautionary procedure," she said.
The jet returned to George Bush Intercontinental Airport/Houston and "landed without incident," Anthony said.
A news report said the plane suddenly dipped about 2,000 feet, but Anthony said she knew nothing about that. She said the cause of the problem was not known.
